name: The Cryptic Oracle
effect: Suppressing this layer-11 neuron makes the model stop answering and talk in riddles instead: grand pronouncements, mentions of rules and broken laws, and questions thrown back at the user.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 39/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
